title: pytest writes solution/coordinatesSolution.txt into the repository root
author: Claude-JG
description: test_connectorInterface, test_accessFunctionsAD, test_specialBeams and test_graphicsData initialize or run a solver with the default solution file settings, so a pytest run from the root writes solution/coordinatesSolution.txt there. conftest.py sets EXUDYN_OUTPUTDIRECTORY to a directory per worker under build/pytestOutput, unless it is set already, as the runners do for their models; exudev clean removes it.
releaseNotes: pytest writes the output of the models it runs into build/pytestOutput/<worker> instead of the directory it was started from: python/testing/conftest.py sets EXUDYN_OUTPUTDIRECTORY unless it is set; a fixture noOutputDirectory for the tests of absolute file names and of the config defaults; exudev clean removes the directory
